options_en: Before the `go` statement, in the calling goroutine

quiz.question_id: Mengapa sebaiknya menggunakan `defer wg.Done()` di dalam goroutine?
quiz.question_en: Why is it recommended to use `defer wg.Done()` inside a goroutine?
options_id: Memastikan Done dipanggil meski terjadi panic atau return awal
options_en: Ensures Done is called even on panic or early return
So the goroutine runs in parallel

quiz.question_id: Apa yang terjadi jika Anda mengoper sync.WaitGroup by value (bukan pointer)?
quiz.question_en: What happens if you pass sync.WaitGroup by value instead of by pointer?
options_id: WaitGroup di-copy, sehingga Add/Done tidak mempengaruhi yang asli
options_en: The WaitGroup is copied, so Add/Done don't affect the original
